ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 2-3 cm each, golden-brown with darker browned edges and crisp-looking surfaces, slightly irregular faces, dry matte sheen, clustered in the upper-left portion of the plate covering about 30% of the plate area, stacked in places to about 2 cm high | 150
ITEM 2 | Off-white, opaque, soft chunks and crumbly flakes with a moist, slightly glossy surface, some pieces smooth and rounded, others broken into irregular pieces 2-4 cm, piled on the right and center of the plate covering about 45% of the plate area, around 1.5-2.5 cm high, holding shape without flowing | 230
